entities.name: Al-Idrisi's World Map (Tabula Rogeriana)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Commissioned by Roger II of Sicily, al-Idrisi created the most accurate world map of the medieval period. Compiled from interviews with travelers, it remained the best world map for 300 years.
